'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Russian invasion of Ukraine]]
**[[Attacks in Russia during the Russian invasion of Ukraine]]
***A [[civilian]] is [[Attacks on civilians in the Russian invasion of Ukraine|killed]] and three others are injured by [[airstrike]]s launched by [[Ukraine]] in [[Belgorod Oblast]], [[Russia]]. [https://tass.com/politics/1759219 (TASS)]
**[[Zaporizhzhia Nuclear Power Plant crisis]]
***[[Russian occupation of Zaporizhzhia Oblast|Russian-installed]] officials at the [[Zaporizhzhia Nuclear Power Plant]] in [[Enerhodar]], Ukraine, say that [[Shell (projectile)|shelling]] has hit [[critical infrastructure]] at the plant and that "such attacks are unacceptable". [https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/russia-controlled-zaporizhzhia-nuclear-plant-says-was-shelled-by-ukraine-2024-03-14/ (Reuters)]
*[[Sudanese civil war (2023–present)|Sudanese civil war]]
**[[Battle of Khartoum (2023-2025)|Battle of Khartoum]]
*** The Sudanese Army captures the Wad al-Bashir bridge in [[Omdurman]]. [https://sudantribune.com/article283321/ (Sudan Tribune)]
*** Sudanese forces capture several [[South Sudan|South Sudanese]] mercenaries fighting for the [[Rapid Support Forces|RSF]] in Omdurman. [https://sudantribune.com/article283328/ (Sudan Tribune)]
**Several civilians are killed after fighting breaks out in Ibtenki refugee camp in eastern [[Chad]]. [https://www.dabangasudan.org/en/all-news/article/sudanese-child-killed-in-chad-refugee-camp-attack (Radio Dabanga)]
*[[Israel–Hamas war]]
**[[March 2024 Kuwait Roundabout attacks]]
***At least 20 people are killed and 155 are injured at a food distribution point in the Kuwait Roundabout. [https://www.cnn.com/2024/03/14/middleeast/blasts-kill-palestinians-food-aid-gaza-intl/index.html (CNN)]
*[[Somali civil war (2009–present)|Somali civil war]]
**[[2024 Mogadishu SYL Hotel attack and siege]]
***An [[Al-Shabaab (militant group)|al-Shabaab]] member [[Suicide attack|blows himself up]] outside a hotel in [[Mogadishu]], [[Somalia]], killing three guards and two security forces. Six gunmen then stormed the hotel in 13-hour siege, causing a gunfight with the [[Somali National Army|army]] in which three soldiers and the six attackers are killed. Twenty-seven other people are wounded. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2024/3/15/al-shabab-fighters-killed-as-overnight-siege-of-mogadishu-hotel-ends (Al Jazeera)] [https://www.ndtv.com/world-news/3-killed-27-injured-after-terrorists-attack-hotel-in-somalias-mogadishu-5244897 (NDTV)]
*[[Western Sahara conflict]]
**[[Western Saharan clashes (2020–present)|Western Saharan clashes]]
*** The [[Sahrawi People's Liberation Army|SPLA]] reportedly attacked Moroccan army headquarters in the [[Al Mahbes|Al-Mahbas]] sector. [https://www.spsrasd.info/en/2024/03/14/2720.html (Sahrawi Press Service)]

'''International relations'''
*[[Russia–United Kingdom relations]]
**A [[Royal Air Force]] plane carrying [[Secretary of State for Defence|UK Defence Secretary]] [[Grant Shapps]] and several journalists has its [[GPS signals]] jammed while flying near [[Kaliningrad Oblast]], [[Russia]]. [[Mobile phone]] signals were also jammed during the flight. The [[Russian Armed Forces|Russian military]] is suspected of being behind the jamming. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/uk-68569676 (BBC News)]

'''Law and crime'''
*[[Iraq]]'s [[National Security Council (Iraq)|National Security Council]] formally bans the [[Kurdistan Workers' Party]] following a high-level meeting between Iraqi and [[Turkey|Turkish]] officials in [[Baghdad]], Iraq. [https://www.al-monitor.com/originals/2024/03/iraq-bans-pkk-security-ties-turkey-gain-momentum (Al Monitor)]
*Police in [[Angola]] report that around 50 people have died after being forced to drink a toxic concoction to [[witch-hunt|prove they are not witches]]. [https://www.cbsnews.com/news/50-dead-anti-sorcery-rituals-mysterious-liquid-angola-officials/ (CBS News)]

'''Politics and elections'''
*[[2024 Croatian parliamentary election]]
**The [[Croatia]]n government votes to dissolve the [[Croatian Parliament|parliament]], thereby requiring that a parliamentary election be held within the next two months. The parliamentary election was originally scheduled to be held on September 22. [https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/croatia-dissolves-parliament-ahead-election-by-may-12-2024-03-14/ (Reuters)]
*[[Conscription in Denmark]]
**[[Denmark]] announces plans to extend [[military conscription]] to women for the first time and to also increase the standard service time. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-europe-68557038 (BBC News)]

'''Science and technology'''
*[[SpaceX Starship integrated flight test 3]]
**[[SpaceX]] successfully launches the first [[SpaceX Starship|Starship]] rocket, the most powerful rocket ever built, at [[SpaceX Starbase|Starbase]] in [[Texas]], [[United States]], after two previous failed attempts. The rocket reached an altitude of more than {{conv|200|km|mi}}, but was destroyed during re-entry. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2024/3/14/despite-problems-spacex-hails-progress-after-third-test-of-starship-rocket (Al Jazeera)]
